preconditions: A 128-byte allocation mapped at guest 0x02000000; input pointer offsets refer to this shared allocation. Private valid stack, DF clear, normal return only; no calls/globals/relocations or stack writes. Nonvolatile registers must be preserved; flags and other volatile registers are unobserved. All 128 bytes are observed after return, including untouched bytes. ECX = allocation base + destination; [entry ESP+4] = allocation base + source. Both offsets plus 16 must be at most 128. Any alignment, equality and overlap are permitted. Only the 16-byte source range may be read and the 16-byte destination range written. Return EAX is a guest pointer normalized by subtracting allocation base. Callee pops four argument bytes.
